about: The six cases C14 runs through the clef supervisor. Each `baseline` is the answer Ollama (clef-flash Q8_0, the spike's runner) gave on these same inputs, run on 2026-11-23; `spike` is the number the spike (PACT-58, round 2) recorded for the case it ran then, whose inputs were not kept. Every text here is plain, invented and holds no secret, personal detail or real path.
bands: A yes/no answer is yes above 0.7, no below 0.3, else unsure. A pick is judged by its top option.
